clue.text: Fancy work by Verdi more relaxed with volume dropped

indicators.note: relaxed suggests the words loosened and reshaped, so the letters are rearranged
dropped says the letter for volume is taken out of the fodder before rearranging

explanation.surface: A critic finds an opera by Verdi a little more laid-back once the sound is turned down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropped' removes V from BYVERDIMORE, leaving BYERDIMORE, which 'relaxed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Needlework decorating cloth is a classic kind of fancy work, a synonym.

clue.text: Deal up to me on right stuff resuming shape

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a deal is a sale
taken as written

explanation.surface: A card player asks for the deal to come round to them on the right.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubber-like polymer that springs back after stretching is a material that regains its form.

clue.text: Live as Mennonite with radiant smile

parts.note: to live is to be, to exist
the Amish are a Mennonite sect

explanation.surface: Someone lives as a member of a plain religious community, smiling broadly.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll coined this word for being cheerful and glowing with happiness.

clue.text: Replacing fluids and salts is boost where egg's eaten

indicators.note: eaten means swallowed, so the egg shape goes inside the joined words

parts.note: a tonic is a boost
an egg is O-shaped, so O

explanation.surface: A sports drink is a pick-me-up, especially when an egg has been eaten too.
explanation.definitionFit: Sports drinks matching the body's salt concentration rehydrate athletes, a technical description.

clue.text: What could give the RA a big shock?

parts.note: shattering the letters of the word for our planet produces THE RA

explanation.surface: Something that might startle the Royal Academy.
explanation.walkthrough: The RA is the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Something momentous and stunning delivers a huge jolt, an idiomatic sense.

clue.text: Cultured fare elevated spirit in Turkic abode

indicators.note: in places the reversed word inside the tent's letters

parts.note: a yurt is a round felt tent of Central Asian Turkic peoples

indicators.note: in a down clue elevated means read upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: go is spirit or energy

explanation.surface: A cultured meal raises the spirits inside a nomad's tent.
explanation.definitionFit: It is made by adding live bacterial cultures to milk, a food.

clue.text: Carbon-free load in mythical ship

indicators.note: -free means without, so the carbon symbol is removed from the word for load

parts.note: a ship's load is its cargo
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A clean-energy freight vessel, lifted straight from legend.
explanation.definitionFit: Jason and the Argonauts sailed in this vessel to seek the Golden Fleece in Greek myth.

clue.text: Instrument area with flashing light around LA

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the flashing-light word encloses LA

parts.note: a strobe is a flashing light

explanation.surface: A device in the area flashes its light around Los Angeles.
explanation.definitionFit: Old navigators used this device for measuring the altitude of stars.

clue.text: Troublemaker good to replace leader in citadel

indicators.note: the first letter of the citadel's name is swapped for the good abbreviation

parts.note: the Kremlin is the citadel of Moscow

explanation.surface: A troublemaker is sent in to replace the leader in a fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: An imaginary imp blamed for mechanical faults, so a mischief-maker.

clue.text: Airborne night flyer having to see slaughter here

indicators.note: borne by air means carried inside it, so the air word holds the next pieces

parts.note: a bat flies at night
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bat in flight at night, tagged along with someone who has to witness a killing.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'Airborne' does two jobs: its first three letters give the container and 'borne' says the flyer and 'to' are carried inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A slaughterhouse is the place where animals are killed for meat.

clue.text: Some shouting at Herod's rally

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crowd at King Herod's court is yelling, as a mob might at a political meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To rally people is to assemble them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Cotton on branch in tree

definitions.meaning: to cotton on is to realise or catch on, a British informal sense
a small shoot or branch on a tree

explanation.surface: A cotton thread caught on a tree branch.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: informal British for understand, and a small branch of a tree.

clue.text: Unholy row with Lord about the Afterlife

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumble goes round the next word
an unholy mess is a chaotic one, so the letters of row and Lord are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An impious quarrel with God concerning what comes after death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unholy' scrambles the letters of 'row' and 'Lord'; 'about' then wraps that jumble around 'the', so the inserted word lands after the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiritual realm beyond death is another world, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Sage old lady, stern, embraces one upright character

parts.note: one's old lady is one's mother, MA

indicators.note: embraces means holds within, so the numeral goes inside the word for stern

parts.note: stern means harsh
I is the Roman numeral one
the letter I is a single upright stroke

explanation.surface: A wise old woman, severe in manner, takes on one person of upstanding character.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu spiritual teacher or guru is a type of sage, like the one the Beatles followed.

clue.text: Legendary heretic seizes day

indicators.note: seizes means grabs and holds, so the heretic's word wraps the day

parts.note: an Arian is a follower of Arius, a heretic
Thur is the abbreviation for Thursday

explanation.surface: A legendary heretic grabs the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the legends of King Arthur and his knights.

clue.text: Female is not in swoon

parts.note: ain't is the informal contraction of is not

explanation.surface: A woman denies being in a fainting fit.
explanation.definitionFit: To swoon is to lose consciousness briefly, a direct synonym.

clue.text: SPECTRE to supply such documents as Bond may see?

definitions.text: such documents as Bond may see?

indicators.note: supply is read as an adjective, supple, so the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: The criminal organisation SPECTRE hands over classified papers for James Bond to read.
explanation.walkthrough: SPECTRE is Bond's enemy organisation; 'supply' is read as 'in a supple way', the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Classified papers of the highest grade are what a secret agent like 007 gets clearance to read.

clue.text: Cardinal taking the high ground?

definitions.meaning: a cardinal is addressed as His ...

explanation.surface: A cardinal claims moral superiority.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the title of honour for a cardinal and also a word for a hill or rise.

clue.text: Course available in religious studies

indicators.note: in places the word for available within the school subject's letters

parts.note: RE, religious education, is the British school subject of religious studies
out can mean available, as a book that is out in the shops

explanation.surface: A course of study offered within a theology programme.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is religious education, a subject in British schools.
explanation.definitionFit: A course is a route or path taken from one place to another.

clue.text: Disgusting incident follows outside broadcast

indicators.note: follows means comes after, so the incident word goes after the broadcast abbreviation

parts.note: a scene is an incident, a public commotion

explanation.surface: A distasteful episode comes after a TV report filmed on location.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indecent and offensive is disgusting, a synonym.

clue.text: Dismissed by university with pressure to get paid

parts.note: in cricket a batsman can be dismissed by being stumped, the wicketkeeper breaking the wicket
P is the symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Someone thrown out of a university under pressure, then paid off.
explanation.walkthrough: Stumped is a cricket dismissal: the wicketkeeper breaks the wicket while the batsman is out of the crease.
explanation.definitionFit: To stump up is British informal for handing over money, often reluctantly.

clue.text: Diminutive Diana Black put out of action

parts.note: Di is the short form of the name Diana
sable is the heraldic word for black

explanation.surface: Little Diana Black is knocked out of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: To incapacitate something is to make it inoperative.

clue.text: Prawns swindle very good indeed

parts.note: a scam is a swindle
pi, short for pious, means very good or sanctimonious

explanation.surface: Someone's prawn deal turns out to be a con.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the breaded Norway lobster tails served as a dish, plural like the definition.

clue.text: Shield of eastern lad covering wounded revolutionary?

indicators.note: covering means wrapping round, so the word for lad encloses the next pieces

parts.note: a lad is a son
wounded means cut
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: An eastern boy shelters a wounded rebel behind a shield.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry this is the shield-shaped surface on which a coat of arms is displayed.

clue.text: Man's one to deceive, not mad, outwardly

indicators.note: not means without, so the letters of mad are removed
outwardly says the letters of mad come off the outside, the M at the front and AD at the back

parts.note: to deceive someone is to mislead them

explanation.surface: A man protests that one may deceive while seeming sane on the surface.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, a self-governing island in the Irish Sea between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Man is an island, so the definition gives a classification of the place.

clue.text: Today's compiler slow to introduce universal method

parts.note: the setter of today's puzzle refers to themselves as me

indicators.note: introduce means bring in, so the universal letter goes inside the word for slow

parts.note: slow-witted means dim
U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: The setter is too slow to bring in a method that works for everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A medium is a means or channel through which something is done, so a method.

clue.text: Lawyers missed start to meal, going by rail

indicators.note: missing its start means the first letter of the meal word is dropped

parts.note: dinner is a meal
a bar is a rail, as on a fence

explanation.surface: Lawyers skip the beginning of dinner because they are travelling by train.
explanation.definitionFit: The senior barristers, King's Counsel, who plead within the bar of the court, form this body of lawyers.

clue.text: Typically long vessel — see one in Hamburg

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see, used in references
ein is German for one

explanation.surface: A long ship is seen moored in the port of Hamburg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a ship; it is a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood vessels carrying blood back to the heart are typically long tubes.

clue.text: I get dinner prepared, using this?

definitions.text: I get dinner prepared, using this?

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so these letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A cook announces they are making dinner, pointing at something in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: what you use when you get dinner ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Each component that goes into a dish is used when a meal is cooked.
